target.title: fix(clawhub): bound archive download bodies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

ClawHub package, ClawPack, skill, resolver, and GitHub-source archive paths all omitted a practical body limit; the shared reader defaulted to `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. A hostile or broken registry could therefore grow gateway memory until the process failed.

Supersedes #100999 because its conflicting branch was converged into a clean maintainer rewrite. Contributor authorship is preserved in the squashed commit.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Give the shared ClawHub byte reader the same 256 MiB archive ceiling already used by marketplace downloads.
- Preserve the explicit 256 KiB skill-card limit.
- Reject trustworthy identity `Content-Length` declarations before buffering while measuring encoded responses from their decoded stream bytes.
- Exercise every archive entry point, declared-oversize cancellation, and encoded-body behavior while retaining the shared reader's streamed overflow guard.

## User Impact

ClawHub installs now fail with a bounded, resource-specific error instead of allowing oversized archive responses to exhaust gateway memory. Normal archives and skill cards keep their existing behavior.

## Evidence

- Targeted `oxfmt --check`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Fresh exact-head high-reasoning autoreview: clean, correctness confidence 0.93.
- Sanitized public-network AWS `run_e3f0cbbdf59e` on the behavior-equivalent pre-rebase head: 66 focused ClawHub tests passed, 2 skipped; no Tailscale, IAM role, credential hydration, or secret forwarding.
- Sanitized public-network AWS `run_1201348c8070`: real `openclaw skills install @steipete/github --global` completed against live ClawHub in an isolated home.
- Sanitized public-network AWS `run_fd976cd2cc27` on the behavior-equivalent pre-rebase head: the live `weather` archive downloaded through `downloadClawHubSkillArchive` (2,013 bytes, 64-character SHA-256) and cleaned up.
- Sanitized public-network AWS `run_bdd373538e73` on the behavior-equivalent pre-rebase head: Node 24 retained a 39-byte gzip `Content-Length` while returning 4,096 decoded bytes, proving encoded wire length cannot enforce the decoded-body cap.
- Exact-head hosted CI is required before merge; run `28821701809` is waiting for repository-wide Actions admission.
- No screenshot: this is a non-UI download-boundary change.
